subject: Publisher channel matrix and onboarding gates for weights access
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@openforge.ai>; OpenForge Labs Partnerships <partners@openforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Publisher channel matrix and onboarding gates for weights access

Elena / team —

Thanks again for the productive sync earlier. Per our conversation, I put together a draft channel matrix for how OpenForge-published weights could flow through Redwood: direct-hosted (Redwood-hosted inference), dedicated pools for ISV partners, and a limited-distribution "weights escrow" path for consultancies that need downloadable access under stricter controls. See attached draft_channel_matrix.xlsx and the partner_onboarding_playbook_v1.pdf for details.

High-level asks from our side so we can finalize the partner offer: 
- Confirm which distribution lanes you need: hosted-only, dedicated-hosted, or downloadable-with-escrow.
- For downloadable access: confirm acceptable licensing model (redistributable vs. hosted-only) and whether you require source-level model artifacts or quantized checkpoints.
- Security/compliance gates: SOC2 attachment, security questionnaire, KMS/HSM requirements — please confirm what your security/compliance team expects.

Operational notes / proposals (open for discussion):
- Tier A (public/payscale): hosted inference + attribution header; no downloadable weights.
- Tier B (ISVs / accredited partners): dedicated pools + per-instance revshare; weights available for on-prem installs under NDA + escrow.
- Tier C (consultancies/tooling partners): conditional downloadable weights, checksum/fingerprint, limited-term license, and model-fingerprint escrow with a notarized agreement.

Timeline suggestion: if you can confirm lanes by next Wednesday (2027-05-05) we can turn around legal and an initial DocuSign NDA in 5 business days and start a 3-week technical onboarding (test harness, perf profile, and catalog readiness).

Next steps I propose: Elena to confirm lanes; Karthik to advise on legal constraints & redlines; Marissa to outline ops checklist and estimate time. Vanessa — I will act as ops lead for Redwood side and coordinate the kickoff.

Attachments: draft_channel_matrix.xlsx, partner_onboarding_playbook_v1.pdf

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Publisher channel matrix and onboarding gates for weights access

Vanessa / Elena —

Quick legal note on the downloadable weights lane so we don't get tripped up later:

1) License boundaries: Redwood can support three high-level licensing templates: hosted-only (API access, no redistribution), limited redistribution (partner may ship in packaged form to end customers but cannot re-license), and full redistributable (rare; requires explicit revenue share & indemnity). We should avoid granting open redistributable rights unless legal signs off on indemnities and attribution.

2) Escrow & custody: For downloadable access we recommend a 3rd-party escrow + notarized manifest that includes a per-checkpoint fingerprint (SHA256) and an agreement for tamper-evident delivery. If the partner requires escrowless delivery, require HSM-wrapped key exchange and an auditable retrieval log.

3) Security clauses: require successful completion of a security questionnaire (we can use our standard redwood-sec-Q1), SOC2 attestation (if the partner will host or serve the model), and explicit KMS/HSM controls for any keying material.

4) Attribution & model cards: must include a model card with license, training data provenance summary (high-level), and allowed uses. We should also append a lightweight fingerprint to tokens so we can track downstream usage in hosted deployments.

I'm attaching my redlines (legal_redlines_openforge.docx) with specific clause suggestions (see CLA-RED-5 for redistribution language and CLA-SEC-2 for escrow). Happy to run a short call with Elena's GC if helpful.

Karthik
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@openforge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher channel matrix and onboarding gates for weights access

Thanks — a few practical ops items from Product/Publishing: 

- Inference qualification: before any distribution lane is opened, OpenForge must provide a test harness (Docker/OCI or a compatible runner) that exercises typical prompt shapes and token lengths, plus an evaluation prompt set. We'll run perf and quality benchmarks (latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, sample outputs).
- Quantization & packaging: we support FP16, int8 + PTQ builds. If you want to ship multiple checkpoints we need a canonical mapping table (checkpoint -> quantization profile).
- Model card & metadata: required fields: license, training data provenance (summary), intended uses, known failure modes, recommended tokenizer and context window, and a small example prompt/response pair for QA.
- Catalog integration: ops checklist is ops_publish_checklist.md (attached). Minimum tech onboarding estimate: 3 weeks (1 week perf & QA, 1 week config and cataloging, 1 week docs & rollout).

Proposal: split onboarding into two sprints — "gating & legal" sprint (owner: Karthik / Legal, 1 week to finalize NDA + license template) and "technical onboarding" sprint (owner: Marissa / Product Ops, 3 weeks). Vanessa to coordinate.

Marissa
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

2) Ops gating (owner: Marissa) — run perf & quality qualification once we have test harness; provide ops checklist and catalog intake form. Target to begin technical onboarding week of 2027-05-17.
3) Delivery lanes: Elena to confirm which distribution lanes OpenForge wants by 2027-05-05. If downloadable weights are requested, we will require escrow or HSM-wrapped delivery and a signed limited redistribution addendum.

I've created a HubSpot deal and bucketed the milestones: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345-OpenForge-RDW (please use that for all milestone updates). I also scheduled a short working call for 2027-05-06 10:00am PT to walk through the channel matrix and agree lanes — invite sent to your inbox.

Elena, can you confirm lanes and whether your GC wants to loop in for a 15-minute review of the redlines? Once we have that confirmation we will issue the NDA + onboarding schedule.

Thanks — excited to get OpenForge models into the Redwood catalog.
